items.value: Ottawa, Ontario — working throughout Ontario, and supporting businesses elsewhere in Canada remotely.

items.a: Ottawa first, then the rest of Ontario, then Canada-wide for anything that works remotely — most of what we do does.
A partner replies personally, usually the same or next business day. There's no ticket queue at this stage of a relationship.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Ottawa?
items.a: Yes — all the work itself is remote, regardless of where you are. If you'd rather talk it through in person first, we're in Ottawa and happy to meet.

items.q: Can I just call instead of filling out the form?
items.a: Yes — the phone number above reaches a partner directly.

cta.title: Not sure where to start?
cta.lead: Tell us what you're running today, on the software side or the marketing side, and we'll tell you what we'd look at first.
cta.note: Ask us if [funding](/funding) might be available.
